title: The Chess Master's Layout
next_chapter_hook: When the first crack appears in destiny's script, the variable never accounted for is quietly changing the entire game...

text.content: Chen Ji snapped his eyes open, cold sweat sliding down his temples. His mother's eyes refused to leave his mind, that thread of guilt like a fine needle, piercing deep into his heart. The moonlight outside the window gleamed like frost. He knew he would never sleep again. Sitting up, he slowly unfolded the Tianji Record Fragment, his fingertips gently touching the yellowed page. "Tianji Record, deduce." His voice was low and hoarse. "I want to see—myself."

Golden runes emerged on the Fragment, intertwining like flowing water into complex脉络. Chen Ji concentrated fully, connecting all his experiences from the past few months: faking his death to escape, infiltrating the Holy Sect, forming an alliance with Ye Qing, even the seemingly perfect scheme to kill Elder Zhang... Each critical node presented a clear trajectory in the Tianji Record's calculation. However, when the deduction reached the fourth layer, his pupils suddenly contracted.

"Impossible..." Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly. The deduction showed that every step he thought he had meticulously planned actually高度吻合 with some mysterious script. Matching rate: ninety-seven percent. The remaining three percent came from his微调 at critical moments—those decisions he believed were flashes of inspiration appeared in the calculation as "error tolerance range." A chill crept up his back, an icy coldness spreading from his tailbone to his skull.

dialogue.content: "What a chess game." Chen Ji let out a low laugh, the laughter full of self-mockery and surging rage. "I thought I was the chess master, but from beginning to end... I was just a piece being moved!" He slammed his fist into the bed frame, wood splinters flying, blood seeping from his knuckles, yet he felt no pain.

text.content: He took a deep breath, forcing himself tocalm. Rage was useless; only analysis remained. He turned the Tianji Record to the first page, where Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickered within the ink marks. "Sir," he began, his voice already restored tocalm, "how much do you know about the fates of all the prophetic ones?" The remnant soul沉默片刻,slowly道:"Young friend, you've finally asked the right question."

dialogue.content: "All prophetic ones are chosen pieces." Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted like wind. "The Eye of Heavenly Secrets chose them, granting Tianji Record fragments, letting them walk the world. However—" He paused. "Not a single prophetic one has survived the fifth complete deduction. After the fifth, the Heavenly Fate Value is exhausted, fate counterattacks, collapsing piece by piece."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart plummeted. He quickly calculated how many times he had used the Tianji Record—the Fragment's awakening, three complete deductions, countless partial glimpses... If following this pattern, how many times had he used? "Sir, how many chances do I have left?" Mo Xiansheng沉默良久:"You... have already used four complete deductions."

Four. Chen Ji's blood seemed to freeze. His faked death plan, his calculations against Elder Zhang, his cooperation with Ye Qing... All of this happened after the fourth deduction. If the fifth deduction would exhaust his Heavenly Fate Value, then every step he took from now on was dancing on a knife's edge. And that chess master clearly understood this better than he did himself.

"The chess master is not the Eye of Heavenly Secrets." Chen Jimurmured自语, fingertips tapping the bed frame. "If it were the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, it would just wait for me to exhaust my Heavenly Fate Value. Why go to all this trouble?" He activated the Tianji Record again, listing all prophetic ones' fate trajectories side by side. An astonishing discovery emerged—every script shared a common endpoint: Heavenly Fate exhausted, fate崩解.

"But there's one problem." A gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he integrated all data for deduction. "If the Eye of Heavenly Secrets is the ultimate chess master, why write a script for each prophetic one? It could control us like puppets." He paused. "Unless—it needs us to choose certain things voluntarily."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji fell into deep thought. To find the script's漏洞, what perspective did he choose to approach this from aftercalm analysis?

choices.description: If the chess master needs prophetic ones to 'choose voluntarily,' what is it after? Reverse reasoning from motivation.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, putting himself in the chess master's perspective. If I were the chess master, what would I need the prophetic one to do? "Choose voluntarily..." He repeated these four words, suddenly opening his eyes. "It needs us to choose rebellion! What the Eye of Heavenly Secrets wants is not puppets, but pieces that can break destiny—because it itself cannot directly intervene in certain matters!"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly: "You've finally touched the edge of truth. All prophetic ones were chosen as keys to challenge a certain forbidden zone. And you—"

text.content: Chen Ji felt a窒息. If what Mo Xiansheng said was true, the situation he faced was more terrifying than imagined. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets had set such an enormous chess game, just to make him 'voluntarily choose' to do something at a critical moment—and that thing was very likely the trigger for his Heavenly Fate exhaustion and fate collapse.

choices.text: Finding the Common Blind Spot in Scripts
choices.description: Since every prophetic one's script was precisely calculated, is there a variable all scripts ignored?
choices.risk_hint: Each deduction consumes precious Heavenly Fate Value

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth, activating the Tianji Record once more. This time, he wasn't deducing the future, but tracing the past—overlaying and comparing all prophetic ones' fate trajectories. Golden runes flashed wildly, fine blood beads oozing from his brow center, intense pain washing over him like tides. But he gritted his teeth and persevered, finally finding an astonishing blind spot among the countless脉络!

"Here..." Chen Ji's trembling voice swelled. "Every prophetic one's script is perfect,唯独 missing this link—!" He pointed to a dim area in the deduction diagram, a corner all fate trajectories steered clear of. There was no calculation there, no prediction, only endless emptiness. "What is this?" He demanded of Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul剧烈fluctuation, his voice showing the first signs of emotion: "That is... emotion. All prophetic ones were taught to sever worldly ties, walking the world with absolute reason. In their scripts, there has never been an uncalculable variable like 'sacrificing for someone.' And you—"

text.content: Chen Ji was stunned. Emotion? Sacrifice? These terms had always been treated as noise in the Tianji Record's deduction system, never factored into calculations. Yet at this moment, a name exploded in his mind like thunder—Tianqing. The youth who blocked a fatal blow for him, the variable that didn't appear in any script yet truly existed.

choices.description: If the Tianji Record is itself part of the chess master's layout, are its operating rules also flawed?

dialogue.content: "Sir," Chen Ji's voice suddenly became very soft, almost inaudible. "Are you truly just a guardian?" The air seemed to solidify for a moment. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slightly凝滞,良久才道:"What do you mean by that?" Chen Ji raised his head, his eyes gleaming with dangerous light: "What I mean is—Are you also part of the script?"

text.content: Silence. Endless silence. Chen Ji almost thought he had provoked this mysterious guardian. Just as he was about to speak and缓和气氛, Mo Xiansheng suddenly burst into laughter—that laughter bleak and mournful, echoing in the night wind. "Good! Good! Good!" He said 'good' three times in succession. "This old man has waited three thousand years, finally meeting someone who dares to ask such a question!"

Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat. Mo Xiansheng continued: "Indeed, I am also a piece. But unlike the others—the old man knows he is a piece, and has been searching for a way to break the game all along." The remnant soul slowly coalesced into a human form, a bitter smile appearing on its illusory face. "And you, young friend, are the first person to give me hope."

Tianqing. Chen Ji silently念叨 this name, an indescribable emotion swelling in his heart. That youth had no connection to him whatsoever, yet appeared suddenly three years ago, persistently begging to become his disciple. At the time, Chen Ji only thought he was another投机者 seeking shortcuts, dismissed him a few times and forgot about it.

Yet precisely such a person, one he had ignored, stood in front of him at the critical moment. That blade was meant for his heart, yet Tianqing blocked it with his own body. Chen Ji would never forget that scene—the youth collapsing in his arms, blood staining half his garment, yet still smiling foolishly: "Mas... Master, did I... not embarrass you...?"

dialogue.content: "You fool..." Chen Ji cursed softly, unsure whether he was cursing Tianqing or himself. He always thought his layout was flawless, yet at that most critical moment, he had deviated from the轨道 because of a person "not in the script." And that deviation was precisely why he survived to this day.

text.content: "So this is the漏洞..." Chen Jimurmured自语, his voice gradually becoming resolute. "What scripts cannot calculate—emotion." He abruptly stood up, tucked the Tianji Record into his chest, and strode to the window. Moonlight fell on his face, illuminating the burning rage and determination in his eyes. "Be it the chess master or the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, you've calculated everything,唯独漏算了人心."

He recalled Tianqing's words before death: "Master, the best thing I've done in this life is not listening." At the time, he only took it as the rambling of a dying youth. Only now did he understand the depth of those words—Tianqing wasn't in the script precisely because he never played by the rules. His reverence for Chen Ji, his dependence, his willingness to die for him... all of this was "error," a variable scripts couldn't predict.

"If emotion is the漏洞..." A sharp gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he rapidly constructed a new deduction diagram in his mind. "I have other emotional bonds I can use." Su Qingyao's trust, Ye Qing's alliance, even Chen Nian's existence... these were all outside the script! Just as he was about to record this discovery, a sudden intense dizziness struck him.

"This is..." Chen Ji grabbed the windowsill, barely stabilizing himself. The Tianji Record in his chest grew slightly warm, the golden runes on its surface beginning to flow on their own, as if responding to his thoughts. A new piece of information flooded his mind—a warning about the "Fifth Complete Deduction": if he insisted on performing the fifth deduction, it would trigger the "fate collapse" counterattack,，届时将必死无疑.

But immediately after, another message appeared: "If a 'variable factor' is implanted before the fifth deduction, the outcome can be rewritten." Chen Ji stared at that line, his heartbeat gradually accelerating. Variable factor—he suddenly thought of Tianqing. Tianqing's sacrifice bought him time, but simple sacrifice wasn't enough; he needed an even more stable "anchor point."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji found the key to breaking the game, but to establish a stable variable factor before the fifth deduction, he needed to make a choice.

choices.description: Su Qingyao's affection level is sufficient to unlock the 'Shared Fate' buff, which can bind her fate with Chen Ji's, becoming the most stable anchor point.

choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may fall into danger because of this

dialogue.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, silently念叨 Su Qingyao's name in his heart. They had crossed paths countless times; she was the person closest to the truth, yet he had resolved her every time. Now, he would proactively reveal everything to her. "Su Qingyao..." he murmured softly. "This time, it's my turn to gamble." Outside the window, the east was already turning white, a new day about to dawn.

text.content: New runes appeared on the Tianji Record—the 'Shared Fate' skill was awakening. Chen Ji felt a warm force surge from the paper's surface, flowing through his meridians throughout his body. That was Su Qingyao's aura, distant yet now resonating with him at this moment. He knew that when Su Qingyao made her choice, she would also become the most critical variable in this chess game.

choices.text: Actively Triggering Chen Nian's Heavenly Fate Interference
choices.description: Chen Nian's existence interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight—this is a double-edged sword, but if used skillfully, it can also cause the chess master's deductions to deviate.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of Exposing Chen Nian's Location
choices.risk_hint: May Put Chen Nian in Greater Danger

text.content: Chen Ji took out a jade slip from his chest, his only proof of connection with Chen Nian. His sister's face surfaced in his memory—the little girl taken by the Holy Sect, he had been secretly searching for her all these years, yet could never pinpoint her location. But now, he had a new idea. Instead of hiding from the chess master's deduction, why not actively release interference waves?

He injected a thread of divine sense into the jade slip, transmitting a message to distant Chen Nian along their bloodline bond. A moment later, the jade slip grew slightly warm, a blurry voice coming through: "Brother...?" That single call made Chen Ji's heart suddenly tighten. He knew that from this moment, the game between him and the chess master had entered a new phase—no longer one-sided scheming, but a chaotic battlefield of mutual interference.

The runes on the Tianji Record suddenly jumped violently, as if sensing some change. Chen Ji stared at those chaotic trajectories, and a cold smile actually curled at the corner of his mouth. The chess master wanted to control him with a script? Let's see, when the script itself becomes blurred, who will be the true winner! He stood up, pushed open the door, and the morning light fell upon him, illuminating the blazing fighting spirit burning in his eyes.

choices.text: Confronting Mo Xiansheng Directly to Pursue the Truth
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng is a guardian who has existed since three thousand years ago; he knows far more than he reveals. Chen Ji decided to lay all cards on the table.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng May Be Hiding Something

dialogue.content: "Sir," Chen Ji's voice was calm yet carried undeniable sharpness. "You said you were waiting for someone who could break the game. Then I want to know—what exactly is this game?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul沉默很长时间, finally sighing: "You really want to know? After knowing, you may regret it." Chen Jisneered一声:"I've already learned I'm a piece. What else is there to regret?"

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted slowly before Chen Ji, complex emotions appearing on its illusory face. "Three thousand years ago, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets discovered the existence of 'Heavenly Will.' That is a consciousness above everything, and it is awakening." His voice grew heavy. "The Eye of Heavenly Secrets wants to prevent its awakening, so it created the Tianji Record, selecting prophetic ones to execute tasks—including pieces to stop it."

text.content: Chen Ji listened,沉默良久. "So, the meaning of my existence... is to become a key that prevents the Heavenly Will from awakening?" Mo Xiansheng nodded: "But this key needs to be activated with one's life. All previous prophetic ones failed, because they couldn't make the sacrifice at the final moment." Chen Ji abruptly raised his head: "But I will not fail. Because—" He paused, an unusual gleam flashing in his eyes. "I have something none of them had."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng looked at Chen Ji, and even his illusory eyes revealed a trace of warmth: "You truly are that person." Chen Ji didn't ask who "that person" was, because he already knew the answer. Emotional bonds—these were what all prophetic ones were taught to abandon, yet precisely the key to breaking the game. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets needed a heartless key, but he could become a sword with affection.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, integrating all information in his mind. The Heavenly Will is about to awaken, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets is laying plans to stop it, all previous prophetic ones were pieces, and he—is the only one with hope of breaking the script. Not because he's smarter, but because he never truly abandoned those "shouldn't have" emotions. Tianqing's sacrifice, Su Qingyao's trust, Ye Qing's alliance, Chen Nian's bloodline... these are all variables outside the script.

"I understand." Chen Ji's voice was low and resolute. "The chess master has been waiting for me to make mistakes, waiting for me to abandon these bonds like other prophetic ones. But they didn't account for—I am atrash, and atrash's specialty is clinging on, refusing to let go." A cold smile curled at his lips, containing rage, resolve, and a long-missing wildness.

Morning light pierced through the thin mist, falling on the rooftops of the Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji stood before the window, gazing at the distant training grounds, yet his thoughts drifted further. The chess master's script continues, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' gaze follows like a shadow, Heavenly Fate Value drains away little by little, and he must find the path not in the script within limited time.

But he was no longer afraid. Because he finally understood one thing—the variable never calculated was never someone else, but himself. Those performances he thought were "trash," those emotions he deliberately hid, those bonds he refused to sever... these are his true weapons. "Come then," he默念 in his heart, eyes burning with blazing fighting spirit. "Since you want to see a script, I'll perform one for you—an ending none of you have ever seen."
